## Download VNB’s Mobile App Today!


When you use the VNB mobile app, it’s like having all our services in the palm of your hand.


No waiting in line, no extra trips, AND the security you can count on. You also can control how your debit card is used and can budget your money using the app. Learn more[here](https://www.vnb.com/products/personal/mobile-banking-personal) .


Download VNB's mobile app in the app store today!


## Need assistance? Contact Us Toll Free at877.817.8621


Our Client Care Center will be happy to assist you Monday - Friday from 8:00 a.m. - 7:00 p.m. and Saturday from 9:00 a.m. - 1:00 p.m. EST.
